tests.note: 14/14 pure fixture tests pass; test count mismatches README/make-result (12)

findings.issue: outDir argument accepted directly without resolving against workspace root; permits path traversal write outside workspace
findings.fix: Resolve path against workspace root and verify target path starts with resolved workspace root before mkdir/write

findings.issue: fs.statSync in readBounded follows symlinks, enabling symlink arbitrary read and target overwrite escapes
findings.fix: Use fs.lstatSync to reject symbolic links via !stat.isSymbolicLink() on both input read and receipt write

findings.issue: validateIntakeRequest does not enforce schema additionalProperties:false or required project_target property
findings.fix: Strictly validate all object keys against schema allowed property set and enforce schema-required field presence

findings.issue: CLI 128 KiB limit diverges from intake.mjs MAX_INPUT_BYTES 64 KiB
findings.fix: Import MAX_INPUT_BYTES from intake.mjs and enforce uniform 64 KiB upper bound in cli.mjs readBounded

findings.issue: sortValue lacks Unicode NFC normalization, causing different UTF-8 representations of identical text to yield divergent SHA-256 digests
findings.fix: Apply String.prototype.normalize('NFC') to string values before hashing

findings.issue: No argument arity or flag validation; unknown flags treated as input file paths; digest subcommand bypasses validation
findings.fix: Implement strict positional arity check, reject unknown flags, and call validateIntakeRequest inside digest subcommand

findings.issue: Credentials/tokens in original_text or unknown_fields persist unredacted into receipt files
findings.fix: Add secret pattern detection and reject or redact potential auth tokens from durable intake receipts

findings.issue: README and make-result.mjs state 12 tests passing, but intake.test.mjs contains 14 tests
findings.fix: Update test count to 14 across README.md and scripts/make-result.mjs

constraints: Path containment uses relative/equality, never naive startsWith; symlink/junction and no overwrite.
Unicode canonicalization must preserve original raw input digest/provenance; no historical receipt rewrites or blanket Unicode rejection.
Explicit secret fields and bounded credential signatures must not become arbitrary token-word rejection; test normal advertising inputs.
Historical immutable source PASS never expires solely because a liveness freshness window elapsed.
